items.quote: Nyel Garani managed public communications on the new scheme for her unit.
She spearheaded incident management during the ransomware attack at the national level.
She spearheaded service-level targets for frontline operations at the national level.
She championed mapping interdependencies across agencies and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
She led the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics across the department.
Nyel contributed effectively to a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading.
Nyel Garani headed cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce, setting priorities for several teams.
Nyel drove steadying a team facing adversity for the whole division.
She managed the migration of core services to the cloud for her unit.
Nyel championed the redesign of the citizen journey for permits and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
